events.title: An equivariant version of Gabber’s lemma
events.description: Gabber’s preparation lemma is a fundamental result in algebraic geometry, originally established by Gabber in 1994 in his work on the exactness of certain Gersten complexes. Following the work of Morel, Gabber’s lemma has become a cornerstone of motivic homotopy theory over fields, the homotopy theory of algebraic varieties.
